I have end stage renal failure and I have lost eight members of my immediate family in recent years. He asked me some questions that I felt were irrelevant and insensitive. When I tried to explain how I was feeling, he interrupted me and said that he understood, but the deaths did not impact my daily life. He also showed no interest in my health issues or how they affected me. I have heard from friends and family that they also do not want to see Dr Riddle as their GP, because he is arrogant and condescending. He acts like he is above his patients and twists their words to suit his excuses. I am a long-standing patient with many health issues and I now feel like I do not want to ask for any support from this practice. Dr Green at the Whins Medical Practice seems to be the only one who cares for his patients and is an asset to the practice. Dr Riddle, on the other hand, should not be allowed to practice medicine.
